text: Implement self-reflection and system limitation analysis in autonomy loop
description: Add reflection step to the autonomous loop: after completing ideas, agent analyzes what worked, what failed, what constraints were encountered, and what system limitations prevented better performance. Uses Aimparency's existing reflection structure (context, outcome, effectiveness, lesson, pattern) to build institutional memory. Loop becomes: discover → plan → execute → verify → reflect → identify improvements → apply improvements → submit. This creates recursive self-improvement where the agent actively works to overcome its own limitations.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Evaluates whether the implemented reflection loop causes useful improvements.
Reflection tied to the connection it tests gives the loop an explicit belief update per hypothesis instead of free-floating lessons.
